case.title: Design: receiving shows a toast with the price and the tier
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is + $ 40.00.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a special-order part not yet received on line 1, category A, cost $0.01.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the part's Receive Part window.
  3. Type 40.00 in Received Cost.
  4. Click Receive.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Receive Part opens as in picture 11.6.

Step 3:

  • Received Cost reads 40.00.

Step 4:

  • A toast reads "Part received".
  • Its second line reads "$80.00 each," and tier A's name, ending with a period ($40.00 + $40.00 = $80.00).
